pages.lesson:
LESSON: PRE READING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 2.1: Pre Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Pre Reading. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Pre Reading
2. Practise Pre Reading at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Pre Reading

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Pre Reading
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Pre Reading. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Pre Reading at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Pre Reading at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Pre Reading
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Pre Reading. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Pre Reading using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Pre Reading in the examples.
2. Explain Pre Reading to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pre Reading.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pre Reading using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Pre Reading important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners track print through have improved. c) appreciate the finger pointing as the teacher importance of reads Variations to this suggestion should be positioning materials

SECTION: REMEMBER

2. Practise Pre Reading at school and at home
